description: The citations twin of 08. Same PDF, same fields, but evidence_mode='citations': the API extracts cited_text from the document server-side, so a quote that has no local substring surface can still be checked against a span the API itself pulled out. Every field therefore demands evidence (min_evidence: 1) and the unverified ceiling is 0.0 -- settings 08 cannot meet, because there the same quotes land evidence_unverified and nothing can prove them. What lands here is api_cited, NOT verified: an API extraction is a second party's reading of the bytes, but it is not a check this harness can re-run offline from text_hash + offsets.
instruction:
The attached document is a two-page supply agreement.

Extract the following.

carrier_name: the legal name of the Carrier, exactly as written.

payment_terms_days: the number of days after invoice date that payment is
due, as an integer.

termination_notice_days: the number of days' written notice required to
terminate for convenience, as an integer.

auto_renews: true if the agreement renews automatically after the initial
term, false otherwise.

For each value, the quote MUST be a verbatim run of characters copied from
the document itself -- the exact words on the page. Do NOT describe where
the text is; do not write 'page 1, clause 2.1' or name a heading. A quote
that describes a location instead of reproducing the text cannot be
checked against the document and will be rejected.

If the document does not state a field, return the absent sentinel and cite
nothing. An honest absence is preferred to an inferred value.

target_fields.name: payment_terms_days
target_fields.description: Days after invoice date that payment falls due.

target_fields.name: termination_notice_days
target_fields.description: Days of written notice to terminate for convenience.
